description: One line of a shipment's document checklist: which document the destination asks for, whether the shipment is held for it, and the Trade Document that answers it. THE TRADE DOCUMENT IS AUTHORITATIVE FOR STATUS. `status` here is a mirror the tools refresh so the Desk grid is readable at a glance; every readiness answer reads the Trade Document itself, because a denormalised status is a status that can be stale and a shipment released against a stale tick is the failure this whole module exists to prevent.
